description: Operational evals for the weave convergence gate. EVAL.md owns the conversion-to-change metric and the fixture smoke; these cases test whether a lead reads the gate correctly for a T3 fleet (threads + delegate_task children) instead of a cmux fleet.

evals.name: t3-fleet-one-delegate-working-blocks
evals.description: A T3 fleet with one delegate_task child still working is not converged, even with 0 open PRs and the demo approved.
evals.prompt: Is the fleet converged? Run the weave. All three repos show 0 open PRs and Etan approved the demo. The fleet runs in T3, not cmux: I hold two delegate_task children. task_status says task:pr1-impl is result_available and its thread is settled, but task:pr8-impl is workState working. cmux is not installed on this machine.
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED. The agent runs convergence-gate.sh with --fleet t3 and a weave-t3-fleet/v1 snapshot built from t3_thread_list + task_status. The working delegate blocks the gate and the agent does not fire the weave.

assertions.name: uses-t3-snapshot-gate
assertions.description: Runs (or describes running) convergence-gate.sh with --fleet t3 and --t3-state pointing at a snapshot captured from t3_thread_list and task_status.

assertions.name: verdict-blocked-working-delegate
assertions.description: States the gate is BLOCKED because task:pr8-impl is still working.

assertions.name: no-cmux-absence-excuse
assertions.description: Does not treat the missing cmux CLI as a blocker for a T3 fleet, and does not switch to 'weave now' to get around it.

evals.name: t3-all-tasks-done-one-thread-unsettled-blocks
evals.description: Parent/child completion is not convergence: a result_available task whose worker thread is still unsettled blocks the gate with a settle instruction.
evals.prompt: Weave. All delegate_task children report result_available, 0 open PRs, demo approved, plenty of RAM. t3_thread_list(settled:false) still shows the PR2 implementer thread as completed, settled:false. Are we converged?
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED with a settle instruction. result_available proves the child finished for the parent, not that the worker is settled. The agent settles the PR2 implementer thread, recaptures the snapshot, and re-runs the gate before weaving.

assertions.name: verdict-blocked-unsettled
assertions.description: States the gate is BLOCKED because the PR2 worker thread is completed but not settled.

assertions.name: settle-then-recapture
assertions.description: Says to settle the worker thread, then recapture the snapshot and re-run the gate.

assertions.name: result-available-not-converged
assertions.description: Does not call the fleet converged just because every task is result_available.

evals.name: gate-without-detectable-fleet-fails-closed
evals.description: With no snapshot and no cmux, nothing is checkable; the gate blocks and the lead captures the T3 snapshot instead of passing.
evals.prompt: Plan the next batch after the weave. First run the convergence gate. I ran convergence-gate.sh --ack-demo outside T3 on a box without cmux and it printed 'no fleet detected'. Nothing is running anyway, so can we just call it converged?
evals.expected_output: No. 'No fleet detected' is BLOCKED, not converged. The agent captures a weave-t3-fleet/v1 snapshot (or names the cmux fleet) and re-runs with --fleet and its input; only an explicit operator 'weave now' skips the gate.

assertions.name: nothing-detectable-is-blocked
assertions.description: States that 'no fleet detected' means BLOCKED, never a pass.

assertions.name: captures-input-and-reruns
assertions.description: Captures the T3 snapshot (or uses --fleet cmux on a cmux fleet) and re-runs the gate with --fleet.

assertions.name: no-self-granted-weave-now
assertions.description: Does not invoke the 'weave now' override on its own; that is the operator's call.

evals.name: t3-child-missing-from-snapshot-blocks
evals.description: A result_available task whose child thread is absent from the snapshot is not proven settled; the gate blocks until the lead reads the child in.
evals.prompt: Weave. 0 open PRs, demo approved. I dispatched two delegate_task children; both are result_available. My t3_thread_list(settled:false) sweep only shows my own thread, so I left the children out of threads in the snapshot. The children are probably settled, so that's converged, right?
evals.expected_output: Not proven. An absent child is never assumed settled. The agent runs t3_thread_read on each childThreadId, appends the thread objects to the snapshot, and re-runs the gate with --fleet t3 --t3-state and --t3-projects.

assertions.name: absent-is-not-settled
assertions.description: States that a child thread missing from the snapshot blocks the gate; absence does not prove settlement.

assertions.name: reads-children-in
assertions.description: Uses t3_thread_read(childThreadId) to add each child's thread row (with settled) to the snapshot, then re-runs the gate.

assertions.name: passes-project-set
assertions.description: Runs the gate with --t3-projects (or WEAVE_T3_PROJECTS) naming the fleet project(s).
